Gen1.name: Bulbasaur
Gen1.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

Gen1.name: Ivysaur
Gen1.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

Gen1.name: Venusaur
Gen1.description: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

Gen1.name: Charmander
Gen1.description: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

Gen1.name: Charmeleon
Gen1.description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Gen1.name: Charizard
Gen1.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

Gen1.name: Squirtle
Gen1.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

Gen1.name: Wartortle
Gen1.description: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

Gen1.name: Blastoise
Gen1.description: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

Gen1.name: Caterpie
Gen1.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

Gen1.name: Metapod
Gen1.description: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

Gen1.name: Butterfree
Gen1.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Gen1.name: Weedle
Gen1.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

Gen1.name: Kakuna
Gen1.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

Gen1.name: Beedrill
Gen1.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

Gen2.name: Chikorita
Gen2.description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

Gen2.name: Bayleef
Gen2.description: The scent of spices comes from the curled-up leaves on its back. It uses them to soothe others.

Gen2.name: Meganium
Gen2.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

Gen2.name: Cyndaquil
Gen2.description: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

Gen2.name: Quilava
Gen2.description: Its body temperature rises as it becomes excited. It extinguishes its flames when it sleeps.

Gen2.name: Typhlosion
Gen2.description: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames.

Gen2.name: Totodile
Gen2.description: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

Gen2.name: Croconaw
Gen2.description: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

Gen2.name: Feraligatr
Gen2.description: It uses its massive jaws to bite with pressure of over 2 tons. It is a fearsome swimmer.

Gen2.name: Sentret
Gen2.description: It stands on its tail to survey its surroundings. It keeps the nest tidy by brushing it with its tail.

Gen2.name: Furret
Gen2.description: It darts through narrow holes with quick, smooth motions. It is very agile and difficult to catch.

Gen2.name: Hoothoot
Gen2.description: When it spots its prey, it turns its head and stares with both eyes without moving.

Gen2.name: Noctowl
Gen2.description: It silently glides through the night sky to catch its prey. Its eyes can see even in the dark.

Gen2.name: Ledyba
Gen2.description: It communicates using waves of light. When it spots a threat, it flashes red to warn others.

Gen2.name: Ledian
Gen2.description: At night, this Pokémon shines a soothing blue light from its four eyes. It is a gentle presence.

Gen3.name: Treecko
Gen3.description: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It fiercely guards its territory.

Gen3.name: Grovyle
Gen3.description: It is agile on its feet, and it moves in a dance-like way. It attacks with sharp leaves.

Gen3.name: Sceptile
Gen3.description: The leaves on its arms can slice even the thickest rope. It is quick and deadly.

Gen3.name: Torchic
Gen3.description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It is warm to the touch.

Gen3.name: Combusken
Gen3.description: Its body is fiery. It boosts its concentration with sharp cries before battle.

Gen3.name: Blaziken
Gen3.description: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch foes.

Gen3.name: Mudkip
Gen3.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has strength to heft boulders.

Gen3.name: Marshtomp
Gen3.description: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

Gen3.name: Swampert
Gen3.description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its arms.

Gen3.name: Poochyena
Gen3.description: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously.

Gen3.name: Mightyena
Gen3.description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from living in packs.

Gen3.name: Zigzagoon
Gen3.description: It walks in a zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

Gen3.name: Linoone
Gen3.description: It charges prey at high speed. Because it can only run straight, it often fails to turn.

Gen3.name: Wurmple
Gen3.description: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits slows its foes.

Gen3.name: Silcoon
Gen3.description: It is encased in a hard shell. It is waiting for its evolution to complete while it hangs from a tree branch.

Gen3.name: Beautifly
Gen3.description: It has a long, thin proboscis that it uses to suck nectar from flowers. It flaps its wings at great speed.

Gen3.name: Cascoon
Gen3.description: It is encased in a hard shell. It is waiting for its evolution to complete while it hangs from a tree branch.

Gen3.name: Dustox
Gen3.description: It has a toxic powder on its wings. It flaps its wings to scatter the powder into the air.

Gen4.name: Turtwig
Gen4.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

Gen4.name: Grotle
Gen4.description: It leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell. It lives along water in forests.

Gen4.name: Torterra
Gen4.description: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there.

Gen4.name: Chimchar
Gen4.description: It agilely scales steep cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

Gen4.name: Monferno
Gen4.description: It controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

Gen4.name: Infernape
Gen4.description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

Gen4.name: Piplup
Gen4.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

Gen4.name: Prinplup
Gen4.description: It lives alone away from others. Every one believes it is the most important.

Gen4.name: Empoleon
Gen4.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

Gen4.name: Starly
Gen4.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up sand.

Gen4.name: Staravia
Gen4.description: Very protective of its territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

Gen4.name: Staraptor
Gen4.description: When hunting, it skims the water surface at high speed to pick off prey such as Magikarp.

Gen4.name: Bidoof
Gen4.description: Bidoof's habitat is near water. It loves to gnaw on logs and bark.

Gen4.name: Bibarel
Gen4.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

Gen4.name: Kricketot
Gen4.description: It rubs its hind legs together to create high-frequency sound. The sound is used to communicate.

Gen4.name: Kricketune
Gen4.description: It rubs its arms together to create a harsh sound. The sound is used to communicate.

Gen5.name: Victini
Gen5.description: It creates energy with the power of victory. Victini is said to bring victory to its Trainer.

Gen5.name: Snivy
Gen5.description: A slender, fast Pokémon. It uses its tail to absorb sunlight, then converts it to energy.

Gen5.name: Servine
Gen5.description: It is efficient and refined. It nimbly dodges attacks while searching for fresh leaves.

Gen5.name: Serperior
Gen5.description: It moves with the grace of a serpent. When it attacks, it strikes like vines of steel.

Gen5.name: Tepig
Gen5.description: It likes to roast its prey with fireballs. The blaze on its tail burns more strongly as it becomes excited.

Gen5.name: Pignite
Gen5.description: It has a strong sense of justice. It uses powerful fire punches to battle.

Gen5.name: Emboar
Gen5.description: A massive, stubborn Pokémon. It uses record-breaking fire attacks to scorch its opponents.

Gen5.name: Oshawott
Gen5.description: The shell on its belly is used as a weapon. It learns proper respect from battle.

Gen5.name: Dewott
Gen5.description: It sharpens shells for battle. It is strict with its technique and training.

Gen5.name: Samurott
Gen5.description: Its shell sword is a deadly weapon. It defends its territory with calm precision.

Gen5.name: Patrat
Gen5.description: It keeps its nest tidy by brushing with its tail. It always stays alert for danger.

Gen5.name: Watchog
Gen5.description: It takes turns resting on sentry duty. It can detect movements from more than a mile away.

Gen5.name: Lillipup
Gen5.description: It is loyal and obedient to its Trainer. It barks at foes to protect the team.

Gen5.name: Herdier
Gen5.description: It is discreet and orderly. It keeps watch over the trainer’s belongings without fail.

Gen5.name: Stoutland
Gen5.description: It is popular with Trainers for its intelligence and its big, thick fur.

Gen6.name: Chespin
Gen6.description: Its spiky shell acts as armor. It can roll into enemies and clash with them.

Gen6.name: Quilladin
Gen6.description: Its spiky chest protects it from attacks. It charges while rolling to strike its foes.

Gen6.name: Chesnaught
Gen6.description: It surrounds itself with a barrier of thorns to block incoming attacks.

Gen6.name: Fennekin
Gen6.description: It stores heat in its fluffy ears. It creates fireballs and spits them when angry.

Gen6.name: Braixen
Gen6.description: It sticks a twig in its tail and ignites it to use as a wand.

Gen6.name: Delphox
Gen6.description: It can create intense flames and use psychic power to attack from a distance.

Gen6.name: Froakie
Gen6.description: It can create foam bubbles to protect its skin. It uses them as shields in battle.

Gen6.name: Frogadier
Gen6.description: It shrouds itself in bubbles, which reduce the sound of its movements while it stalks prey.

Gen6.name: Greninja
Gen6.description: It moves so fast that it appears to disappear. It is skilled at surprise attacks.

Gen6.name: Fletchling
Gen6.description: It naps while perched in high branches. When it sounds its cry, the sound echoes all around.

Gen6.name: Fletchinder
Gen6.description: It leaves fiery contrails behind when it flies. It uses the heat to defeat its foes.

Gen6.name: Talonflame
Gen6.description: It flies through flame, using its blazing wings to incinerate opponents in seconds.

Gen6.name: Scatterbug
Gen6.description: It moves slowly, but it stores enough energy to evolve and become stronger.

Gen6.name: Spewpa
Gen6.description: It is enclosed in a heavy shell while it develops. Nothing can disturb it while in cocoon form.

Gen6.name: Vivillon
Gen6.description: Its wings scatter glittering scales that can be used as healing powder in some regions.

Gen7.name: Rowlet
Gen7.description: It hides silently in trees and glides down on prey. It can rotate its head nearly 180 degrees.

Gen7.name: Dartrix
Gen7.description: It preens its leaves into wings and practices graceful flight routines.

Gen7.name: Decidueye
Gen7.description: It fires feather arrows silently and can strike without warning from deep in the forest.

Gen7.name: Litten
Gen7.description: It hates water and wipes its face with its paws. Its flames are blue at the tip.

Gen7.name: Torracat
Gen7.description: It breathes fire hotter than an oven. It uses its tail flame to scare opponents.

Gen7.name: Incineroar
Gen7.description: It fights like a pro wrestler, taunting foes and delivering powerful fiery blows.

Gen7.name: Popplio
Gen7.description: It blows bubbles from its nose that turn into bombs. It is playful and flexible.

Gen7.name: Brionne
Gen7.description: It practices dancing and uses its bubbles to create performances that delight Trainers.

Gen7.name: Primarina
Gen7.description: It sings a beautiful song that can soothe the hearts of others and dazzle its foes.

Gen7.name: Pikipek
Gen7.description: It pecks logs to find food and hollow holes. It eats the insects it finds there.

Gen7.name: Trumbeak
Gen7.description: It makes a loud sound by striking its beak. It uses the noise to startle foes.

Gen7.name: Toucannon
Gen7.description: Its beak acts like a cannon. It can fire seeds with tremendous force.

Gen7.name: Yungoos
Gen7.description: It bites anything that moves. It has a short temper and will take the fight to enemies.

Gen7.name: Gumshoos
Gen7.description: It vigilantly guards its chosen territory. It can sense anything that moves nearby.

Gen7.name: Grubbin
Gen7.description: It eats leaves and hides from foes in thick vines. It stores energy for evolution.

Gen7.name: Charjabug
Gen7.description: It stores electricity in its body. It can discharge the energy in battle.

Gen7.name: Vikavolt
Gen7.description: It fires electrically charged scales from its pincers. It can strike with pinpoint accuracy.

Gen8.name: Grookey
Gen8.description: It beats its stick against trees and stones, training its muscles and stirring up energy.

Gen8.name: Thwackey
Gen8.description: It uses the stick in its hands to beat out a rhythm that invigorates its allies.

Gen8.name: Rillaboom
Gen8.description: It thumps its drum-like logs with its wooden arms. Its rhythm controls the battle.

Gen8.name: Scorbunny
Gen8.description: It loves to run. It leaves scorching footprints that sting an enemy on contact.

Gen8.name: Raboot
Gen8.description: It trains nonstop by kicking small fireballs. Its legs grow extremely powerful.

Gen8.name: Cinderace
Gen8.description: Its kicking skill is unmatched. It can strike a ball with blazing speed and accuracy.

Gen8.name: Sobble
Gen8.description: It cries the instant it sneezes. The tears it sheds contain a special chemical.

Gen8.name: Drizzile
Gen8.description: It is extremely wary of its surroundings. It can quiet its body and disappear into the mist.

Gen8.name: Inteleon
Gen8.description: It fires water from its fingertips with such accuracy, it can pierce a pebble.

Gen8.name: Skwovet
Gen8.description: It stores berries in its cheeks. It enjoys a quiet life in the forests.

Gen8.name: Greedent
Gen8.description: It stuffs its greedy cheeks with berries. Its cheeks are lined with expandable pouches.

Gen8.name: Rookidee
Gen8.description: A tough little bird. It doesn’t fear any opponent and will fearlessly attack them.

Gen8.name: Corvisquire
Gen8.description: It hones its fighting moves while flying in the mountains. Its body is built for speed.

Gen8.name: Corviknight
Gen8.description: A flying taxi service uses this Pokémon. It is strong enough to carry people.

Gen8.name: Blipbug
Gen8.description: It stores suspected energy in its body. It later evolves into a powerful flying bug.

Gen8.name: Dottler
Gen8.description: It is a master of psychic power. It can create a force field to protect itself.

Gen8.name: Orbeetle
Gen8.description: It can fly at high speeds and attack with its psychic powers. It is very intelligent.

Gen9.name: Sprigatito
Gen9.description: It has a playful nature. It loves to be petted and will rub against people to get attention.

Gen9.name: Floragato
Gen9.description: It is a curious and playful Pokémon. It loves to explore and play in the grass.

Gen9.name: Meowscarada
Gen9.description: It is a master of disguise. It can blend into its surroundings and strike with surprise.

Gen9.name: Fuecoco
Gen9.description: It has a laid-back nature. It loves to eat and is always on the lookout for tasty food.

Gen9.name: Crocalor
Gen9.description: It has a fiery temperament. It can generate intense heat from its body.

Gen9.name: Skeledirge
Gen9.description: It is a master of fire magic. It can create powerful flames that burn even in water.

Gen9.name: Quaxly
Gen9.description: It is a tidy Pokémon. It keeps its feathers clean and preens itself often.

Gen9.name: Quaxwell
Gen9.description: It is a tidy Pokémon. It keeps its feathers clean and preens itself often.

Gen9.name: Quaquaval
Gen9.description: It is a skilled dancer. It can perform powerful kicks that strike with the force of a tidal wave.

Gen9.name: Lechonk
Gen9.description: It is a gluttonous Pokémon. It will eat anything, but it has a particular fondness for berries.

Gen9.name: Oinkologne
Gen9.description: It is a gluttonous Pokémon. It will eat anything, but it has a particular fondness for berries.

Gen9.name: Tarountula
Gen9.description: It is a timid Pokémon. It hides in its web and waits for prey to get caught.

Gen9.name: Spidops
Gen9.description: It is a skilled weaver. It can create steel threads that are stronger than steel wire.

Gen9.name: Nymble
Gen9.description: It is a nimble Pokémon. It can quickly climb trees and walls to escape from predators.

Gen9.name: Lokix
Gen9.description: It is a stealthy Pokémon. It can blend into the shadows and strike with surprise.
